Protests Erupt Over Ticket Denial, Disrupting Highway and Clashing with Police

Supporters of a former MP minister blocked National Highway-44 in Datia following the denial of a party ticket. The protest escalated into violence, with demonstrators clashing with police, engaging in stone-pelting, and vandalism. The former minister was subsequently summoned to Bhopal.
